workingTitle: Marathon's Future Questioned as Bungie Delays Big Update and Scraps Seasonal Schedule

secondary.title: Marathon's Future Questioned as Bungie Delays Big Update and Scraps Seasonal Schedule
Bungie delays next Marathon update and ends 'strict seasonal schedule' as it goes all-in on Destiny-like features
Marathon's permanent PvE mode and next major update delayed to December days before launch, and Bungie's "moving away from a strict season schedule"
Marathon Delays Next Major Update, Puts Focus on PvE, and Moves Away from Seasonal Content Amidst Bungie Struggles
Marathon Delays New Content And Ditches Seasons As Bungie’s Extraction Shooter Fights For Its Life

singleSourced.value: We’ll release a smaller, focused update on October 6 that resets progression and the in-game economy, refreshes rewards, and improves the live game.
singleSourced.context:
Still, there will be a smaller patch dropping in the meantime: "We’ll release a smaller, focused update on October 6 that resets progression and the in-game economy, refreshes rewards, and improves the live game."

The broader context here is that Bungie wants to rework its development schedule.

"October gives us an opportunity to apply what we learned and establish a healthier progression experience."

The October refresh will also see the Vault Breaker PvE mode brought back for a limited time, and there will be other "gameplay experiments" between the October refresh and Symbiosis update in December as well.

singleSourced.context: That's the big one: PvE will finally be made a permanent mode, and there will be a new Runner shell, a "social space with a firing range," an experimental Team Deathmatch mode, and various other improvements.

singleSourced.key: the content originally planned for september will now arrive as part of our symbiosis update on december 8
singleSourced.value: The content originally planned for September will now arrive as part of our Symbiosis update on December 8.
singleSourced.context:
"The content originally planned for September will now arrive as part of our Symbiosis update on December 8."

December's Symbiosis update is promising a new Runner shell, the aforementioned permanent PvE mode, a social space where players can try out weapons together, improvements to the onboarding experience for newcomers, a "refreshed Perimeter zone" and an "experimental" team deathmatch mode.
